title: Welcome to the MML!
author: League Office
summary: The Mario Mania League has a brand new home!
body:
# Welcome to the brand new MML website!

### All the Mario Mania League information is here for you anytime!

On this MML hub, you will have access to view all the info you could possibly need in regards to each game, player, team, GM, schedule, and so much more!

Keep a look out for articles like these, as several GMs, players, and writers will be providing fantastic updates here!

If you have any questions, comments, recommendations, or anything, please feel free to reach out in the Level Up for Charity discord in the #mario-mania-league chat!

Regards,
The League Office
